llm.summary: Measured RAG Studio implements a hybrid dense-sparse RAG pipeline with reciprocal rank fusion and local LLM evaluation. While the modular concept and README documentation are strong, the project suffers from a non-functional main script due to mismatched function imports, hardcoded external URLs, UI coupling in core modules, committed build artifacts, and an absence of automated tests.

dimensions.rationale: Code in src/ is cleanly written with type annotations, but main.py fails immediately upon execution because it imports non-existent functions from the src modules.
Responsibilities are divided across loader, retriever, chain, and evaluation modules, but framework coupling exists with Streamlit caching inside retriever logic and configuration is hardcoded.
No unit, integration, or regression test suites exist in the repository.
README includes a clear architecture diagram, results summary, and quickstart commands, but omits prerequisites for the Ollama setup and ngrok proxy requirements.
A live ngrok tunnel URL is hardcoded into the source code, user upload paths are constructed without sanitization, and no environment variable management or .gitignore is configured.
The repository includes a requirements file, but it commits binary .pyc files and .DS_Store, lacks a .gitignore file, contains no CI workflow, and has no open-source license.

top_fixes.action: Fix broken imports (load_and_chunk_docs, build_retrievers, evaluate_retrieval) to match the actual function signatures defined across src/loader.py, src/retriever.py, and src/evaluate.py.
Extract the hardcoded ngrok base URL into an environment variable loaded via python-dotenv with a configurable local fallback (e.g., http://localhost:11434).
Add a .gitignore file containing __pycache__/, *.pyc, .DS_Store, and untracked chat/result dumps, then remove committed .pyc files from git tracking.
Remove Streamlit imports and the @st.cache_resource decorator from core library code, moving UI-specific caching up into app.py.
Add pytest tests verifying that CustomEnsembleRetriever correctly fuses scores and ranks documents using reciprocal rank fusion.

strengths: Comprehensive README featuring a Mermaid pipeline diagram and quantitative benchmark comparisons.
Custom implementation of Reciprocal Rank Fusion (CustomEnsembleRetriever) combining dense FAISS embeddings with BM25 keyword search.
Clear separation of concerns across document ingestion, retrieval mechanics, prompt chains, and benchmark evaluation.

mentor_flags: 1 cited file path(s) did not exist and were removed -- review may be unreliable.
Repo was large; only a sample of files was reviewed.
